# Synthetic fixture

`minimal-pe-x64.exe` is generated byte-for-byte by `python3 tests/make_minimal_pe.py`. It is a minimal PE32+ x86-64 image used only to exercise Phase 0 parsing and report generation. It contains a `RET` byte and padding, has no symbol table, and is not a real-world executable or benchmark. The test suite passes it to NexussREV for static parsing; it is never launched.
